description: An invalid restored observation discards only its boundary assignment. A short circuit can preserve the other assignment (engine §4.2).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text $x:X B
%conditions $x.parse(q).tags = ∅
%rule q $y:r
%conditions ¬($y.without-elision.parse(rival)) ∨ $.followed-by(B)
%rule r (r [+U]) :: Recursive | X :: ∅
%rule rival X
